get.description: Returns the rooms currently available for the specified location, including measurements and overview images. Depending on your integration and property setup, this endpoint may return no results. If you expect room data for your locations and are not seeing it, contact NavigateAI.

get.description: List the live line item rejection reason options configured for the requesting organization.

Fetch a single line item rejection reason option by id for the requesting organization.

Unlike the list endpoint, this point lookup returns soft-deleted options as well, so that
integrations can resolve historical `rejection_reason_option_id` values already stored on
line items even after the option has been deleted.

UpdateLineItemRowRequest.description:
Request schema for updating a line item row.

All fields are optional. Omitting a field leaves it unchanged.
Some fields may be explicitly set to null to clear the value.

title.title: Title

description.description: Updated line item description. Omit to leave unchanged.
description.title: Description

price_reference_key.description: Pricing item reference key. Set to null to clear. Omit to leave unchanged.
price_reference_key.title: Price Reference Key

notes.description: Line item notes. Set to null to clear. Omit to leave unchanged.
notes.title: Notes

status.description: Updated line item status. Omit to leave unchanged.
status.title: Status

rejection_reason_option_id.description: ID of the selected [rejection reason option](/api-reference/rejection-reason-options/rejection-reason-option-object). May only be set when the resulting line item status is `rejected`. Will be cleared otherwise. Omit to leave unchanged.
rejection_reason_option_id.title: Rejection Reason Option Id

rejection_reason_text.description: Free text rejection reason for additional context. May only be set when the resulting line item status is `rejected`. Will be cleared otherwise. Omit to leave unchanged.
rejection_reason_text.title: Rejection Reason Text

ScopeDetailExternalSchema.description:
The full scope resource including line items, keyed by Scope.Id.

This intentionally omits workflow-ish fields like status and completed_by.
Those semantics are still evolving, while this resource is meant to expose
the stable customer-facing scope object.

initial_visit.description: The visit that produced this scope.

ScopeThinExternalSchema.description:
Lightweight scope schema for list endpoints.

Related resources are referenced by id only; fetch the full object via its
own endpoint when needed. This keeps list payloads small and avoids coupling
list responses to the shapes of Location and Visit.

Also intentionally omits workflow-ish fields like status and completed_by.
Those semantics are still evolving, while this resource is meant to expose
the stable customer-facing scope object.

initial_visit_id.description: The visit that produced this scope, if any.
initial_visit_id.title: Initial Visit Id

ScopeThinExternalSchema.title: ScopeSummary

UpdateVendorOrganizationRequest.description:
Every field is omit-to-preserve: only fields present in the request body are applied.

All fields except email are non-nullable: their `default=None, validate_default=False` keeps them
optional without advertising `null` as an accepted value, matching UpdateMarketRequest.
